categories: Of the King of Israel and/or Messiah
Ps 2:7.rationale: The LORD declares to His installed King and Anointed on Zion, "You are My Son; today I have begotten you."

categories: Of the King of Israel and/or Messiah
Ps 2:12.rationale: "Kiss the Son" refers back to the royal Son of v. 7. However, the Hebrew bar is disputed; some translate it "kiss purely" or "kiss his feet."

Hos 11:1.rationale: God calls the nation Israel 'My son,' called out of Egypt; the parental imagery of the chapter continues this.

Hos 11:10.rationale: The returning Israelites are called the LORD's 'children' (banim), continuing the chapter's portrayal of Israel as God's son.
